acceptanceCriteria: the #947 repro selects only tests/alpha.spec.ts for src/contexts/alpha.ts with accessor-key-nonliteral count 0
shadowed, let/var-bound, reassigned or template-with-substitution identifiers stay non-literal, with tests
NGI-V0 rule recorded; the issue is closed with the PR
body: GitHub #947 (owner, feature request on the #871 dialect, V1-1365). createTestData(SCENARIO_CONTEXT) with const SCENARIO_CONTEXT = 'ctx:delta' at top level of the same spec is accessor-key-nonliteral, which widens every caller at 600 for every key; in one real suite ~60 of 165 non-inline calls use this form, so the dialect never narrows there. Multi-line and generic-call literals already resolve. Request: when the first argument is an identifier bound by a top-level const NAME = '<closed literal>' (or substitution-free template) in the same file with no reassignment possible, treat it as that literal key. Imported consts are out of scope.
title: impact: string-key-registry dialect reads a same-file top-level const string as a literal accessor key (GitHub #947)
